inlines.v: PORTENT'OUS, adjective [Latin portentosus.] Ominous; foreshowing ill. Ignorance and superstition hold meteors to be portentous 1. Monstrous; prodigious; wonderful; in an ill sense. No beast of more portentous size, In the Hercynian forest lies.
